cold_init_ns.scope: same pinned current compiler, both trace arms; collector entry to initialization response including authority/setup/startup
cold_init_ns.rationale: Rounded to 10 ms above 294341500 ns across all 70 successful sessions; replaces the old 180 ms queued-run budget, whose samples remain intact.

queued_interval_ns.scope: legacy current arm; adjacent queued response arrivals
queued_interval_ns.rationale: Retained legacy ceiling above 129549694 ns over 65 intervals; distinct from interactive round trips.

query_latency_ns.scope: both trace arms; all 140 non-initialize request round trips, including tool-level error responses
query_latency_ns.rationale: Rounded to 10 ms above observed maximum 160166838 ns; five repetitions per case/arm, no percentile inference.

instrumentation_overhead_ns.scope: absolute trace-on minus trace-off round-trip delta; same binary/stdlib/query and matched repetition, alternating order
instrumentation_overhead_ns.rationale: Noise-inclusive regression guardrail rounded to 10 ms above max absolute paired delta 40576264 ns. Signed range -40576264 to 22033936 ns; not an estimate of isolated observer cost or evidence of speedup.

peak_rss_bytes.rationale: Cgroup memory.peak is a memory-charge substitute, not a process-tree RSS measurement.

context_usage.rationale: Private model context occupancy is not exposed. Host input tokens are recorded separately as input_tokens_context_proxy.

peak_memory_charge_bytes.scope: private cgroup: supervisor after migration, namespace init, worker and descendants; excludes collector
peak_memory_charge_bytes.rationale: 129 MiB: next whole MiB above 134561792 bytes over 70 successful sessions. Kernel memory charges include anonymous/file/kernel accounting, with shared charges possibly elsewhere; this is not RSS or retained heap.

input_tokens_context_proxy.scope: twelve preserved pilot rows; host-accounted cumulative inputTokens, including cached input
input_tokens_context_proxy.rationale: Rounded to 1000 above observed maximum 70893 tokens. Context-cost proxy may count repeated/cached input across turns; private context occupancy remains unknown.
